title: A HashiCorp Vault is exposed and unsealed
summary: A Vault health endpoint answers here and reports the vault unsealed, which means its secrets can be read over the network.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("\"sealed\":false") or body_contains("\"sealed\": false")) and (body_contains("cluster_name") or body_contains("\"initialized\"")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put Vault behind the network boundary it is meant to sit behind, and review whether it should be reachable here at all.
